articles.summary: Anfield Energy announces the pricing of its US$6.0 million underwritten public offering of common shares to support corporate growth and operations.
articles.title: Anfield Energy Announces Pricing of US$6.0 million Underwritten Public Offering of Common Shares

articles.summary: Anfield Energy expands its Colorado land position through a new perpetual mining lease, strengthening the JD-5 and Slick Rock uranium-vanadium projects.
articles.title: Anfield Energy Announces Lease of Additional Patented Mining Claims Expanding Land Holdings for JD-5 and Slick Rock Projects

articles.summary: Anfield Energy closes a US$6.9 million underwritten public offering to advance its U.S. uranium projects, mill development and working capital.
articles.title: Anfield Energy Closes US$6.9 million Underwritten Public Offering

articles.summary: Anfield Energy receives ATF blasting permits for Utah and Colorado mines, advancing mine development and supporting its path toward near-term uranium production.
articles.title: Anfield Energy Inc. Receives ATF Blasting Permits for Utah and Colorado Mines
